prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
The best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice combine depth psychology, somatic awareness, and contemplative traditions to help integrate hidden parts of the psyche. Sounds True +2
Format: 7-week guided course.
Focus: Blends Tibetan Buddhist methods with modern mindfulness, insight training, and Western psychology. It uses guided meditations, dream work, and deep psychological inquiry to befriend the shadow with loving-kindness. www.awakeacademy.org
Format: On-demand video and audio lectures ($127).
Focus: Explores how the shadow forms through early adaptation, projection in relationships, and repeating life patterns, aiming to foster psychological responsibility and self-realization. Jung Platform
Format: 12-week self-paced audio and prompt-based course.
Focus: Uncovers, processes, and integrates unconscious limiting beliefs, trauma, and repressed self-aspects through mindful observation and journaling. (Note: Recommends having a support system as the work can be emotionally taxing).
Format: Self-paced digital courses (blending modalities like Internal Family Systems and somatic practice).
Focus: Integrates modern brain science and psychological healing with spiritual wisdom traditions for emotional and inner growth. Sounds True
Format: Accessible-level video and downloadable journaling prompts.
Focus: Covers heart-chakra self-care, identifying triggers, projection, fear, and direct communication with the shadow self. Udemy
Format: App-based multi-day audio and somatic courses.
Focus: Combines mindfulness, art therapy, parts dialogue, and body-based inquiry to look honestly at personal conditioning. Insight Timer +1
